Experience at CocoCamp
Jan 2024 • Friends
Cococamp is a restaurant located on Kỳ Co beach, a beautiful and secluded spot in Quy Nhon, Vietnam. The restaurant is made up of several bamboo bungalows perched on the rocks overlooking the ocean. The views are simply stunning, and the atmosphere is relaxed and peaceful.
The food at Cococamp is equally impressive. The menu features a variety of fresh seafood dishes, all of which are cooked to perfection. We tried the grilled squid, the steamed clams, and the fried fish, and all of them were delicious. The prices are also very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the food.
The service at Cococamp is excellent.

Food and ambiance at Cococamp
Aug 2023 • Friends
I'd like to share my personal review of Cococamp restaurant in Quy Nhơn. It's a fantastic place to enjoy delicious food and experience a beautiful atmosphere.

Cococamp's menu is diverse, and their talented chefs ensure you get to savor mouthwatering and fresh dishes. Especially, the seafood here is often exceptionally good due to its proximity to the sea.

The restaurant's ambiance is cozy and airy, with a backdrop of Quy Nhơn's picturesque coastal scenery. The service is also excellent, with friendly and attentive staff.

Overall, Cococamp is an excellent choice for dining and relaxation in Quy Nhơn, and I highly recommend giving it a try if you have the opportunity.
